text: The Cyclone Reinsurance Pool (CRP) is a government-backed initiative in Australia, administered by the Australian Reinsurance Pool Corporation (ARPC). It aims to provide affordable and available reinsurance solutions for cyclone and cyclone-related flood risks, particularly in cyclone-prone regions like Northern Australia. The CRP operates under a AUD 10 billion Commonwealth guarantee, allowing for risk-based reinsurance pricing without private-market profit margins. It covers household, strata, and SME property insurance, with insurers ceding cyclone risk to the pool in exchange for a premium.
